title: Team
description: A franchise. Deliberately lightweight: a team owns very little data itself — its ROSTER is derived by filtering league.players for players whose teamId matches this team's id. This keeps player ownership in exactly one place and makes trades a one-field update.

id.description: Short, unique, stable team code (e.g. 'BAY'). Referenced by player.teamId, draft.order, history, and transactions.

conference.description: Optional grouping (e.g. 'East'/'West'). Not required by the engine.

championships.description: Running title count, incremented by simulateSeason.js when this team wins it all.

colors.description: Team palette. Drawn into the crest wherever the team appears.

color.description: Legacy single colour, kept so pre-palette saves still render.

emoji.description: Crest glyph, used when no logo has been uploaded.

logoPrimary.description: Uploaded logo as a downscaled PNG data URL, or null.

population.description: Metro population in millions. Market size is derived from it.

depthChart.description: Ordered player ids per position, starters first. Reconciled against the roster on read: ids no longer on the team are dropped and unlisted players are appended at their primary position, so it self-heals after waives and trades.
